title: Kissed Korean Poppy Seed Flatbread
description: A fermented, flaky, gluten‑free flatbread infused with ground poppy seeds, cooked traditionally in a clay pot for a tender, aromatic finish.
instructions: In a mixing bowl combine rice flour, sea salt, sugar, and instant yeast.
Add warm water and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Stir in ground poppy seeds and fermented soybean sauce until evenly distributed.
Transfer dough to a lightly oiled container, cover with plastic wrap, and let ferment at room temperature for 4 hours.
After fermentation, gently knead the dough on a lightly floured surface until it becomes smooth.
Roll the dough into a 0.5 cm thick circle, about 20 cm in diameter.
Lightly oil a preheated clay pot and lay the dough inside, sealing the edges with a small amount of dough.
Cover the pot with a lid and steam on medium‑high heat for 15 minutes.
Carefully flip the flatbread, reapply a thin layer of oil, and steam for an additional 5 minutes until golden and airy.
Remove the flatbread from the pot, cut into wedges, and serve warm or let cool for meal prep portions.
